jobs.description:
La Cote International School (LCIS) is a school that aims to make a difference every day. We are passionate about education and seeing young people grow and develop, and we want the same for our colleagues. If you join us, you will become part of a team that is a genuine family, committed to each other and to the students we serve. LCIS is a co-educational, English language based, day school that welcomes nearly 450 students between 3 and 18 years old. Nestled in Switzerland amongst vineyards and fruit orchards, between Lac Léman and the Jura mountains, we are also within very easy commuting distance from Geneva and Lausanne. It is a truly great environment to live and work.

We offer our students unparalleled international learning experiences, including those inspired by our collaborations with Juilliard, MIT and UNICEF. Our customized curriculum offers our students the opportunity to follow an English, French or bilingual pathway leading to the internationally renowned International Baccalaureate Diploma Program (IBDP), as well as discovering new skills, abilities and interest. It is in this dynamic environment that we invite you to apply to join our team:

Learning Support Assistants (Student Shadows)

Speculative applications – primary – secondary – hourly role

Responsibilities:

• Provide support to students with additional learning needs within the classroom.

• Motivate students to achieve beyond their potential.

• Encourage students to communicate effectively.

• Help children understand instructions.

• Assist children who need extra support to complete various tasks.

• Supervise group activities.

• Communicate with teachers, the SEN department and parents about student progress.

Qualifications and Skills:

• 1-3 years of experience in a similar role.

• Fluency in English; working knowledge of French is an asset.

• Relevant degree.

• Excellent communication skills, discretion, and a team player attitude.

• Empathetic, calm, positive, motivational, creative, and flexible.

• Availability throughout the day and week during school hours.

• Local residency.

• Clear criminal record.

If you are passionate about education and interested in joining our team, please apply directly online through our website. Please note that this is an ongoing advertisement, as we may have unexpected Learning Support needs arise throughout the year, though there may not be an immediate vacancy at this time.

If you share our passion for education and would like to join our team, please apply directly online through our website.

jobs.description:
Founded in 2008, La Côte International School is a co-educational, English-language-based day school for students aged 3 to 18. Situated in Aubonne, Switzerland—within easy reach of Geneva and Lausanne—our school is home to nearly 450 students representing a variety of cultures and backgrounds.

At LCIS, we offer a unique blend of international education and strong local community ties with English, French, and bilingual pathways, leading to the globally recognized International Baccalaureate Diploma Programme (IBDP). Through exclusive collaborations with Juilliard, MIT, and UNICEF, we deliver enriching opportunities that inspire students to thrive academically, creatively, and personally. It is in this dynamic environment that we invite you to join our team as:

Teacher of Physical Education (maternity replacement)

100% – from December 2026 to October 2027

Responsibilities:

• Deliver the teaching and learning of physical education throughout the whole school effectively

• Contribute to a programme of trips, excursions, fieldtrips and extracurricular activities

• Coordinate the school ski programme of ski days, residentials, ski club and ski team

• Lead and participate in primary and secondary winter and summer residential trips

• Lead and participate in the sports department residential trips

• Accompany the teams to sport tournaments

• Promote the health and safety of assigned classes

• Participate in professional development and contribute to regular staff training/meetings

• Enhance the professional standing of the teaching body

• Contribute to the development of a positive attitude between the physical education department and the wider community through cooperative relations, publications, competitions etc.

• Complete the role of a secondary school home room teacher each day

Qualifications and skills:

• Bachelor or Masters degree in physical education with QTS status or equivalent

• Must be a competent skier who can navigate intermediate to difficult terrain, including race pistes. Experience of racing and a ski qualification would be an advantage

• Proven track record of excellence in teaching with at least three years’ experience, ideally in an international environment

• Knowledge and proven experience in teaching physical education in early years and primary

• Experience in managing trips and/or ski programmes is an advantage.

• Fluency in English, ability to speak French would be desirable

• Excellent communication skills and team player

• Have the ability to manage a diverse and demanding workload

• Strong organisation skills and use of technology for administration and teaching

• First aid qualification or willingness to achieve this

• Clear criminal extracts

• Valid work permit

If you share our passion for education and would like to join our team, please apply directly online through our website.

Assistant-e Socio-éducatif-ve

100% – dès décembre 2026

• Bonne connaissance du développement de l’enfant et expérience professionnelle auprès d’enfants en bas âge (0 à 5 ans).

jobs.description:
Primary Teacher (Maternity replacement)

100% – January 2027 to May 2027

Responsibilities:

• Deliver a high standard of learning, development and care for children, ensuring that the individual needs and interests of each are met.

• Ensure effective delivery of the curriculum to specified classes, including selecting resources and managing them efficiently in the classroom.

• Build and maintain a strong partnership with parents to enable children’s needs to be met.

• Provide a safe, secure and stimulating environment enabling children to reach their potential.

• Contribute to a programme of trips, excursions, fieldtrips and extracurricular activities.

• Enhance the professional standing of the teaching body.

Qualifications & Skills:

• Bachelor in Education, PGCE or equivalent.

• Proven track record of excellence in teaching with at least five years’ experience, ideally in an international environment.

• Be an organised, proactive and excellent communicator and team player.

• Have the ability to manage a diverse and demanding workload.

• Be able to inspire mixed culture and ability classes, by creating challenging and engaging learning opportunities for all students.

• A collaborative, innovative, and student-centered approach to education.

• Valid work permit

• Clear criminal records.
